transactionMappingCoverage.rule: Catalog mapping does not classify historical transactions. Every financial record still needs its own scope and evidence or remains quarantined.

defaultReportingRule: No center enters Dreamcatcher reporting automatically. Center 1 is the only hotel routing candidate, but each record needs transaction-level scope evidence; centers 2-10 are excluded and center 11 is quarantined until approved.
crossScopeRule: No raw cross-business consolidation. Any portfolio view must use an approved relationship, purpose, permission, aggregation level and effective period.
sharedCostRule: A shared expense needs source document, legal entity, benefiting scopes, allocation basis, percentages or driver, effective dates, reviewer and reconciliation; otherwise PENDING_EVIDENCE.
